description: Double Shock: in the setup turn Jolteon's Double Shock hits Blissey and Jolteon's Electric type becomes `???` (`self.onHit`); Blissey's own Double Shock fails without an Electric type (`onTryMove` returns null). In the scenario turn Jolteon's second Double Shock fails; Zapdos's hits Snorlax and leaves it `???/Flying`; Blissey's Stomping Tantrum keeps its base power (a `null` last turn is no failure) and is neutral on the `???` Jolteon; Snorlax's Thunder Wave can paralyze Jolteon, no longer Electric.
